source_caption_text:
4Xtra Goes Viral After Being Seen Outside With Kendrick Lamar Earlier Today 👀🔥

4Xtra is a Los Angeles rapper, internet personality, and content creator known for his outspoken personality, street credibility, and strong presence in LA’s hip-hop culture. Representing South Central Los Angeles, 4Xtra gained popularity through viral social media videos, interviews, and appearances on No Jumper alongside Adam22. He has built a following by showcasing local businesses, sharing stories about his upbringing, and representing West Coast street culture. His music includes tracks like “OFF THE BACC” and “Bag & Tag Em.” He also made national headlines following a fireworks accident in July 2025. 

Kendrick Lamar is a Grammy Award-winning rapper, songwriter, and one of the most influential figures in hip-hop history. Born and raised in Compton, California, Kendrick rose to superstardom with his critically acclaimed albums good kid, m.A.A.d city, To Pimp a Butterfly, DAMN., and GNX. Known for his storytelling, lyricism, and dedication to representing Los Angeles, Kendrick has become a global icon while continuing to embrace his West Coast roots. His massive hit “Not Like Us” became a cultural phenomenon, further solidifying his legacy. He also made history by becoming the first rapper to win a Pulitzer Prize for Music and headlined the 2025 Super Bowl halftime show. With 27 Grammy Awards, Kendrick remains one of the most decorated rappers of all time.
